comment: The ground scatter's rules (ScatterView; Phase A, the visual audit's V3): presentation data, not game content - nothing here changes a
rule, a save or the content hash. Each kind is a procedural mesh scattered in MultiMesh chunks of chunk_m, placed from the world seed.
Densities are per square metre on each ground, by the ground's world material (the art bindings' terrain map says which cell wears which),
blended across cell borders as the terrain shader blends the grounds. Nothing is placed inside a building or a structure's footprint, and
every kind thins out over clear_margin metres from buildings, walls, rocks, containers, stations and people; nothing on a worn path (unless
off_path is false), under water (below never.below_height_m) or on ground steeper than never.slope_over (rise per metre). Paths are the
worn strips the terrain shader draws and the scatter leaves bare, by region ID: polylines of [x, z] metres, path.width_m wide.

region.ashen_hollow.note: the lodge's east door, round to the smithy's door
from the smithy's door past the well to the waystone
a fork east from the lodge door to Sel's table

grass.note: Clumps of three crossed alpha cards; straw-coloured on worked dirt and gravel, green in the wood and the wet; a trodden bare yard round the buildings; thinner under the canopies.

leaves.note: Flat cards of fallen leaves, densest within a few metres of a trunk.

stones.note: Noise-displaced pebbles to head-sized stones in the limestone material, sunk a third; kicked to the paths' shoulders.
